Hi Julia — thanks for the screenshot, that helps.

Quick notes from ops:
- Our default invite token is single-use and expires after 24 hours. If the user hits the token-expired page and retries quickly, the OTP endpoint will lock additional attempts for 10 minutes (security throttle). That matches what you're seeing.
- Manual provisioning is available for exceptions: we can create the vendor user and attach the paperwork (W9) on your behalf, then send a 'set password' link that avoids the OTP flow.

Two options:
1) Manual provision now — please reply with the name, email, and a scanned W9 (PDF). We'll attach it to the vendor record and generate a set-password link (ETA 2 hours).
2) If you prefer to try self-serve again, I'll invalidate the previous token and issue a new one with a 72-hour window; ask your team to use the invite from a single browser session and avoid multiple OTP attempts.

For speed, option 1 is recommended given your PO timing. If you confirm, I will provision and notify once the record is active.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Vendor Onboarding Lead — Redwood Dedicated Ops
